recipe.name: Instant Pot Ghee
recipe.summary: A simple Instant Pot ghee made with just good unsalted butter, cooked till nutty and then strained.
recipe.summary_plain: A simple Instant Pot ghee made with just good unsalted butter, cooked till nutty and then strained.

items.name: unsalted butter
items.notes: Kerrygold or another good quality butter
items.text: 1 pound unsalted butter, Kerrygold or another good quality butter

steps.text: Put the butter in the Instant Pot and turn it to saute on high.
steps.text_plain: Put the butter in the Instant Pot and turn it to saute on high.

steps.text: Once the butter has melted, turn the heat to low and cook till a white froth comes to the top and it smells nutty.
steps.text_plain: Once the butter has melted, turn the heat to low and cook till a white froth comes to the top and it smells nutty.

steps.text: Turn off the Instant Pot, lift out the inner pot and set it on a trivet to cool slightly.
steps.text_plain: Turn off the Instant Pot, lift out the inner pot and set it on a trivet to cool slightly.

steps.text: Strain into a clean glass jar and let it cool. The ghee is ready.
steps.text_plain: Strain into a clean glass jar and let it cool. The ghee is ready.
